answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 8401 Country: India Title: I want to ask that if a boy can be named mikhail or djibril (jibril). Is it true that mikhail is the name of a farishta? pls also give the meaning of the names? Question: Assalamwalaikum, I want to ask that if a boy can be named mikhail or djibril (jibril). Is it true that mikhail is the name of a farishta? pls also give the meaning of the names? Answer ID: 8401 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1283/1097=L/1429) Yes, one can name a child with Mikail or Jibrail. Yes, it is right that Mikail is an angel who is appointed by Allah to supply maintenance. We do not know the meaning. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
